_doc: VOICE ABILITY LIBRARY for The Squeeze. Every ability is a workplace action or state of mind spoken with conviction: the clearer and more forceful the delivery, the higher the resonance. school must be one of PYROMANCY/CRYOMANCY/ELECTROMANCY/NATURE/HOLY/SHADOW/PHYSICAL. Names are calibrated so each contains exactly one thematic root word of its own school (resonance guardrail). aliases are fuzzy voice-match keywords. manaRestorePct > 0 marks the free breath/attune discipline.

spells.name: Line Drill
spells.description: The basic rhythm of the line: case, scan, slot, move on. Free, tireless, always available.

spells.name: Freight Push
spells.description: Shove the wall of boxes forward with your whole body instead of letting it win.

spells.name: Hold Ground
spells.description: Plant your boots. Halve the incoming damage of the next assault — the mart stays up.

spells.name: Breathe
spells.description: The breath discipline: center yourself for three seconds in the break room and a third of your resolve returns.

spells.name: Clear Dock
spells.description: Sweep a lane of pallets clean in one run — the receiving dock breathes for five minutes.

spells.name: Grind Out
spells.description: The stubborn hour: no breaks, no conversation, just the grunt work until the pallet is gone.

spells.name: Backroom Haul
spells.description: One trip, everything: the armload of a dozen boxes carried all the way to the shelf.

spells.name: Mend Crew
spells.description: Patch up the associate next to you — a promised swap of the worst task, a cold drink from your bin.

spells.name: Steady Hands
spells.description: Breathe calm over the whole crew; everyone's wobble smooths out for a beat.

spells.name: Calm Floor
spells.description: A flat, even voice that lowers the temperature of the aisle; incoming pressure half-lost before it starts.

spells.name: Soothe Crew
spells.description: Talk someone down off the register ledge — a real conversation instead of a walkie squawk.

spells.name: Listening Session
spells.description: Ten minutes of actually hearing the complaint; the wound doesn't close, but it stops bleeding.

spells.name: Morning Surge
spells.description: The 9:58 open flood — one impossible surge of customers and you ride it like a current.

spells.name: Floor Charge
spells.description: Hit every department you own like a battery reconnecting — the floor snaps alive.

spells.name: Spark Ideas
spells.description: One decent suggestion that short-circuits the old way of doing it.

spells.name: Static Pressure
spells.description: The ambient voltage of the floor: a shock that stuns the problem into stillness.

spells.name: Quick Flash
spells.description: That split-second of certainty when you see the whole 12-box pattern at once.

spells.name: Burnout
spells.description: The 48-hour grind pushed to its breaking point — readiness corrodes from within.

spells.name: Heat Grill
spells.description: The unrelenting heat of the back-line grill: pressure applied until the other side cracks.

spells.name: Flare Up
spells.description: The rare, honest flash of anger you let someone actually see. Just one. Then it's gone.

spells.name: Searing Shift
spells.description: The closing heat of a double shift — you're already burned, so you don't feel it anymore.

spells.name: Cold Start
spells.description: The 3:57 AM ignition of the building — dead quiet, frozen aisles, and you keying the world awake.

spells.name: Frostbite
spells.description: The freezer lane visit that numbs your hands and slows the clock to a crawl.

spells.name: Deep Freeze
spells.description: The frozen-food wall: everything stops — you, the aisle, the week — for a long, white moment.

spells.name: Quiet Chill
spells.description: The hush after close, when the ballasts hum and the store belongs to the overnight crew.

spells.name: Grow Crew
spells.description: Train the green hand into a full associate — watch them rise instead of quit.

spells.name: Root Cause
spells.description: Stop patching the symptom; trace it back to the source and tear that out instead.

spells.name: Second Seed
spells.description: The second chance offered to someone the machine has already written off.

spells.name: Canopy Shield
spells.description: Spread yourself thin over the whole department like a canopy — the storm hits you first, all of it.

spells.name: Night Shift
spells.description: The signature overnight strike: unseen work in the dark that nobody thanks and everyone needs.

spells.name: Shadow Doubt
spells.description: Plant the suspicion that your enemy planted first — turn the machine's whisper back on it.

spells.name: Backroom Whisper
spells.description: The conversation that happens at the baler, in the smoke break, just out of camera range.

spells.name: Drain Energy
spells.description: Take the good shift from someone who stole yours first — hours, favor, standing, all of it.
